text: The intent of this motion is for staff to come back with a report for stopping prohibitions on Bombay Avenue to address the concerns of parked tow trucks in the area.

North York Community Council: 1. Requested the General Manager, Transportation Services, to investigate the need for a stopping prohibition on Bombay Avenue, east of Avenue Road/Bideford Avenue, to address concerns with parking tow trucks, and report back to North York Community Council.
